samples.question: The ringed token starts in the large 3 by 3 grid, whose cells are labeled A through I from left to right and top to bottom. Read the six cards from left to right. A horizontal band rotates its highlighted row one cell right; a vertical band rotates its highlighted column one cell down, with wraparound. In which cell does the ringed token finish? Answer A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, or I.
